name: novadde
description: NovaDDE, Geodesic Intelligence's AI co-scientist for drug discovery: run protein design and structure models on Geodesic GPUs, billed to your Model Platform credits.

interface.longDescription: Run Geodesic Intelligence's protein design and structure models (BoltzGen, Boltz-2 and more) on Geodesic GPUs from Codex. Every job is billed to your Model Platform credits: NovaDDE estimates the cost first and asks before it submits. Needs a Model Platform API key saved in ~/.config/geodesic/model-platform.env; the catalog works without one.
defaultPrompt: What models can NovaDDE run, and what do they cost?
Show my Geodesic credits and recent jobs
Estimate, then fold this sequence with esmfold
